reviews.text: I had a groundhog under my porch and finally caught him in a live trap. I called Nuisance Wildlife at 11:00 and George was here by 1:00 to take it away. He gave me some advice on keeping critters and him away down the road.
reviews.author: Brian G.

reviews.text: We’ve had bat problems in our old house for the past four years. We found a live bat under our piano. George came out quick, was very knowledgeable, and finished the job quickly for us. I definitely recommend his services!
reviews.author: Brielle S.

reviews.text: This guy is a no nonsense wildlife nuisance removal service. Excellent communication on phone and always careful to maintain safety and respect to the animal. He removed a possum for me that was living under a building.
reviews.author: Mike C.
